title_original: ‘Star Trek,’ ‘X-Men’ & ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ Stars Remember Patrick Stewart: “A Singular Talent, A Generous Collaborator & A True Gentleman”

blocks.text: Patrick Stewart , the actor from Star Trek and X-Men , has died and Hollywood is reacting to the news.

“We announce with great sorrow the passing of Sir Patrick Stewart yesterday at his home in Los Angeles, in the loving care of his beloved wife Sunny, following a brief and poignant journey with Alzheimer’s Disease and Lewy Body Dementia,” spokesperson Kelly Bush Novak said in a statement.
RELATED: Patrick Stewart Dies: ‘Star Trek’ & ‘X-Men’ Actor Was 86

links.text: Patrick Stewart Dies: ‘Star Trek’ & ‘X-Men’ Actor Was 86

blocks.text: With Stewart’s death, the tributes and homages to the late actor have come pouring in which you can scroll through in the list below.
Some of Stewart’s friends who have paid tribute to him include Hugh Jackman, Marvel head Kevin Feige, William Shatner, George Takei, Kumail Nanjiani, and more.

blocks.text: Hugh Jackman Image Credit: 20th Century Fox Hugh Jackman : “We lost one of the greats of stage and screen today. And, in my book, a tremendous friend and man. I learned so much from him. I will miss you, Patrick Stewart, all of my days.” View this post on Instagram //platform.instagram.com/en_US/embeds.js

blocks.alt: Patrick Stewart and Hugh Jackman in 2017's 'Logan'
blocks.caption: Image Credit: 20th Century Fox

blocks.text: Marvel Image Credit: Marvel Patrick Stewart reprised his X-Men role for Avengers: Doomsday , and Marvel had some words following news of his death. “All of us at Marvel Studios are deeply saddened by the passing of Sir Patrick Stewart,” read Marvel’s social media post. “Sir Patrick brought Professor Charles Xavier to life with extraordinary grace, intelligence, and humanity, defining the character for generations of fans, from X-Men to Logan to Avengers: Doomsday. He was a singular talent, a generous collaborator, and a true gentleman. Our hearts go out to his wife Sunny, his children, his friends, and the countless fans around the world whose lives he touched with his art.”

blocks.alt: Patrick Stewart es Professor X in 'Avengers: Doomsday'
blocks.caption: Image Credit: Marvel

blocks.text: Kevin Feige (Marvel Studios President) Image Credit: Gilbert Flores / Getty Images Kevin Feige : “I’ll never forget the first time I saw Sir Patrick Stewart on the set of the first X-Men. After years of knowing him as the inimitable Captain Picard, I was in awe — and he turned out to be everything I had seen on screen and more: brilliant, charming, warm, generous, with a quiet strength and gravitas. Away from the cameras, he was even more remarkable, with a wonderfully sharp sense of humor.” He continued, “It was a true privilege to know him and to work with him. His legacy lives on not only in decades of extraordinary work, but in the many, many people he mentored. He will be deeply missed.”

blocks.caption: Image Credit: Gilbert Flores / Getty Images

blocks.text: Kumail Nanjiani Image Credit: Disney/Elizabeth Sisson Kumail Nanjiani : “Sir Patrick Stewart was the best. I don’t know what else I can say.” Sir Patrick Stewart was the best. I don’t know what else I can say. — Kumail Nanjiani (@kumail.bsky.social) 2026-10-29T19:54:27.504Z https://embed.bsky.app/static/embed.js

George Takei Image Credit: Paramount TV George Takei on Threads : “Fans across the world mourn the passing of a true and irreplaceable legend. As Captain Jean-Luc Picard, Patrick Stewart took the starship Enterprise to places it had never gone before, and he inspired a whole next generation of star-gazers who looked longingly ahead to a brighter future for all humanity. Our hearts are heavy, indeed. Rest in the heavens, Captain.”

William Shatner Image Credit: Paramount TV William Shatner : “What a heartbreaking week it has been. Sir Patrick Stewart was a friend, a colleague, and a magnificent actor. From the stage to the bridge of the Enterprise, he brought intelligence, grace, and a deep sense of humanity to everything he did. Captain Picard stood for the best of us, and so did the man who played him. I was filled with affection and admiration for him and his work. My heart goes out to Sunny and his family. He will be deeply missed.” What a heartbreaking week it has been. Sir Patrick Stewart was a friend, a colleague, and a magnificent actor.
